name: Tortilla Soup
description: A flavorful Mexican-inspired soup with chicken, vegetables, and crispy tortilla chips.

recipeInstructions.text: Saute chicken pieces with onion, garlic, and spices until chicken is cooked through.
Add 4 cups water and boil to make stock.
Remove chicken and chop, discarding any bones and skin.
Combine remaining ingredients (except tortilla chips, sour cream, and cheese) and heat through.
To serve, place tortilla chips in soup bowls.
Pour soup over chips and top with sour cream, jalapenos (optional), and shredded cheddar cheese.

keywords: tortilla soup, Mexican soup, chicken soup, spicy soup

_similar.name: French Onion Soup
_similar.description: A classic French onion soup made with caramelized onions, consomme, and topped with melted mozzarella cheese and croutons.
recipeIngredient: 4 Oxo cubes dissolved in 2 cups hot water

recipeInstructions.text: Melt butter. Saute onions until transparent.
Add to Oxo, consomme and water. Simmer about 2 hours.
Put in onion soup bowls, add a slice of French bread on top of each one and add shredded mozzarella cheese sprinkled over each.
Put in oven at 350°F for 30 minutes.

_similar.keywords: French onion soup, caramelized onions, melted cheese

_similar.name: Mexican Salad
_similar.description: A hearty and flavorful salad with kidney beans, lentils, and low-fat cheese, topped with salsa and served with taco chips.
recipeIngredient: ½ cup low-fat cheese (mozzarella or cheddar or combination)

recipeInstructions.text: Combine kidney beans, lentils, diced tomato, shredded lettuce, chopped green pepper, low-fat cheese, and green onions in a large bowl.
Toss the salad with Catalina dressing until well coated.
Top the salad with salsa.
Serve immediately with taco chips on the side.

_similar.keywords: Mexican salad, bean salad, taco chips

_similar.name: Pasta & Bean Soup
_similar.description: A hearty and flavorful soup featuring pasta, beans, and vegetables in a tomato-based broth.
recipeIngredient: 19 oz can white kidney or romano beans, drained
10 oz can chicken broth, diluted with 1 cup water
3 cups small shell pasta or macaroni

recipeInstructions.text: Place oil in a large pan over medium heat. Stir in onion, carrots, celery, and garlic. Cook, uncovered, stirring often, until onion is soft, about 5 minutes.
Add broth, tomatoes and juice, seasoning, and beans. Break up tomatoes. Increase heat to medium and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Uncover, increase heat, and bring to a boil. Add pasta or macaroni. Boil gently, uncovered, stirring often, for about 8 minutes.
If desired, add additional hot broth or water for more broth. Stir in basil and Parmesan. Serve immediately.

_similar.keywords: pasta soup, bean soup, Italian soup, vegetable broth

_similar.name: Mexican Enchilada Bake
_similar.description: A hearty, layered casserole featuring chicken, tortillas, and a rich tomato-salsa sauce, topped with cheese and sour cream.
recipeIngredient: 2½ cups tomato sauce or ¾ cup each diced carrots and diced canned tomatoes
1 can (19 oz) black beans, rinsed and drained

recipeInstructions.text: Combine tomato sauce, salsa, 2 teaspoons chili powder, and 2 teaspoons cumin in a medium saucepan. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 5 minutes.
In a large bowl, mix together chicken, rice, beans, carrots, red pepper, onion, lime juice, cilantro, remaining 2 teaspoons chili powder, and remaining 1 teaspoon cumin.
Spray a 9×13 inch baking dish with nonstick spray.
To assemble the casserole, spread 1 cup of sauce over the bottom of the baking dish. Arrange 6 tortillas over the bottom, overlapping as necessary.
Spoon another 1 cup of sauce over the tortillas and spread evenly. Top with half of the bean mixture and half of the cheese.
Arrange the remaining tortillas, top with another 1 cup of sauce, followed by the remaining bean mixture and remaining cheese.
Spoon any remaining sauce over the top. Cover with foil and bake at 350°F for 35 to 40 minutes until bubbly and heated through.
Let stand for 5 minutes before serving. Top individual servings with a dollop of sour cream.

_similar.keywords: enchilada bake, Mexican casserole, chicken recipe
